Definition
[W-entropy definition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 11.1\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals \begin{equation} {\mathcal W}(g,f,\tau )=\int _M\left[\tau (|\nabla f|^2+R)+f-n\right](4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-f}dV. \end{equation}

It is invariant under $\phi ^*$ and under $(g,\tau )\mapsto (cg,c\tau )$. On flat $\mathbb R^n$, $\tau =-t$, $f=|x|^2/(4\tau )$ satisfies (41), (42), and ${\mathcal W}=0$ by (17)--(18).
